title: Путёвка от Елены Павловны  (A Vacation Voucher from Elena Pavlovna)

segments.t: Outside the hospital, Elena Pavlovna reminds Chef Barinov that his doctor strictly forbade any kitchen work during his recovery. To make sure he actually rests, she surprises him with a vacation voucher for a flight departing in just four hours.
Надо как-то заскочить к вам в ресторан, посмотреть.
Ну, а что вы так реагируете.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'No work whatsoever, do you understand?' Notice how Russian expresses 'out of it' and 'did you understand?' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Yes, yes, no work at all.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'yes' before landing on 'of work'.
'Do you understand? Yes?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'you' and finishing on 'yes'. Vika answers right away.
Надо как-то заскочить к вам в ресторан, посмотреть.
'I should drop by your restaurant sometime to take a look.' The grammar packs 'at' and 'to look up' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Where are you rushing off to like that?' Here Chef Barinov anchors the thought on 'where to' and finishes on 'to be in a hurry, to hurry', keeping the spoken rhythm brisk and natural.
'If you also stop by to have a meal.' The meaning hinges on 'if' working together with 'to eat' in spoken Russian. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'Viktor Petrovich.' Notice how Russian expresses 'Viktor' and 'Petrovich' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Your plane leaves in four hours.' Vika anchors the line on 'four', while 'plane' completes the thought.
Ну, а что вы так реагируете.
'Well, why are you reacting like that.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'come on' and finishing on 'to react'. Vika answers right away.
'Wait, right now?' The meaning hinges on 'what' working together with 'any minute' in spoken Russian.
'Right this minute? Well?' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'simply', while 'come on' completes the thought.
'Well, no.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'yes' and finishing on 'there is no'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'I am ready.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'I' and 'ready' in a few short words. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
Надо как-то заскочить к вам в ресторан, посмотреть.
Ну, а что вы так реагируете.

That wraps up this scene as as Chef Barinov leaves the hospital under strict orders not to work, Elena Pavlovna surprises him with a last-minute vacation flight leaving in four hours. See you next time!
